svg.title: Statement commitment / סוף גזרתו
svg.desc: Chapter 6, Hebrew p75, English p76. Identify exactly what a statement asserts, on which its truth or falsity depends. Four focusing corners enclose the entire established violet statement tile. The whole tile represents the statement generally, not only the Simple form. The focus can be on a dependence, a qualified predication, or multiple constituent assertions, according to the statement. This is not its predicate alone, a newly deduced conclusion, a truth endorsement, an essence, or an eleventh-plus-one statement form.
